sloka: अयं हि जलसम्भूतो मणिः सज्जनपूजितः ।यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तः शक्रेण धीमता ।। ५.६६.५ ।।।।
transliteration: ayaṁ hi jalasambhūto maṇiḥ sajjanapūjitaḥ ।yajñe paramatuṣṭena dattaḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā ।। 5.66.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "This was found in water and was bestowed by Indra out of great joy on Janaka who had performed a grand sacrificial ceremony. So it was worshipped by elders of the family.
translations.hindi: पहुँच ज्ञाता हुआ यहाँ से कोन लोट क्षकता हे ?
